fact: The article says the Independent Information Commission is enforcing compliance with the country's Freedom of Information Act of 2010 across public bodies.

The article reports the Independent Information Commission, with an Executive Director and outreach and compliance directors, running a compliance campaign under the Freedom of Information Act from 11 August to 2 September 2026; the document gives no date for the Commission's setting up, so this is dated to its publication on 6 September 2026.

The Press Union of Liberia president urged the Civil Service Agency to align its new staff confidentiality and non-disclosure agreement with Liberia's Freedom of Information Act, treating the Act as existing law; the article gives no date for the Act, so the article's publication date is used.

The Press Union of Liberia's president refers to the Freedom of Information Act as in operation, passed 16 years before the 2026 report, and says the Act is being undermined by a new civil service confidentiality agreement.

The Press Union of Liberia says the Independent Information Commission is the statutory body charged with enforcing the Freedom of Information Act and that it publicly opposed the Civil Service Agency's confidentiality policy.
The Analyst reports that Liberia enacted its Freedom of Information Act in 2010 and that the Independent Information Commission surveyed awareness of it in Grand Gedeh County in October 2026.

The Independent Information Commission, led by Information Commissioner Joash T. Hodges with compliance and outreach directors, is reported at work running a knowledge survey in Grand Gedeh County on 14-17 October 2026.
The Press Union of Liberia president said the Freedom of Information Act was passed more than 15 years ago and is being enforced by the Independent Information Commission, whose audit he cited.

The Press Union of Liberia president described the Independent Information Commission as the state authority legally mandated to enforce the FOI Act, which he said opposed the civil-service confidentiality agreement.
